want: the Android app organised into four bottom tabs with a central Add button
soThat: the most-used actions are reachable in one tap instead of hunting through seven flat tabs
acceptance: the Android bottom navigation has exactly four tabs: Home, Transactions, Budget, and Accounts
adding a transaction is a floating button beside the toolbar rather than a navigation tab
the Budget tab reaches the budget, cards, installments, and insights views, and the Accounts tab reaches balances, and settings through its menu button
Home is the destination shown when the app launches
the Budget tab's Insights view shows the spending dashboard with the category donut and transport-by-provider breakdown
tapping the central Add button opens the add-transaction form in a modal bottom sheet, and saving it closes the sheet and returns to the current tab
